svg.text: Mechanism of each step in the VLM progression
Schematic. □ image feature ● prompt / class ○ synthetic feature.
Unique symptom words pull same-crop prompts apart,
towards visual concepts CLIP already knows.
Crop and disease vectors move to where seen images lie;
unseen pairs reuse them, but seen scores now dominate.
Small adapters re-shape CLIP's image features for leaves:
each image moves to its own prompt, away from others.
A GAN turns unseen pair text into synthetic features, so
the classifier gets examples of every pair (less bias).
Start from a real healthy leaf of the crop and learn only
the disease offset: synthetic features land near real ones.
Score = ConvNeXt crop + CLIP disease. Each part is learned
from real images; an unseen pair is just a new combination.
The router keeps G's seen/unseen decision; seen images
go to the ConvNeXt, the stronger seen classifier.
Subtract γ from every seen-pair score: borderline
images switch to the best unseen pair.
